text.zh-CN: 围绝经期是卵巢功能和月经规律发生变化到最后一次月经前后的过渡阶段；它是生命阶段，不是每个人都会严重不适。
text.en: Perimenopause is the transition around the final menstrual period as ovarian function and cycle patterns change; it is a life stage, and severe symptoms are not inevitable.

supports.assessment: Transition and variability.

text.zh-CN: 潮热是脸、颈或胸部突然发热，可能出汗或夜间醒来；也可能出现睡眠、情绪、阴道干涩和性交疼痛问题。
text.en: A hot flush is sudden heat in the face, neck or chest, sometimes with sweating or night waking; sleep, mood, vaginal dryness and painful sex may also change.

supports.assessment: Recognizable manifestations.
Independent symptom explanation.

text.zh-CN: 自然绝经通常在45–55岁发生；排除其他原因且连续12个月没有月经后才能回顾性确认。激素避孕或手术会使判断不同。
text.en: Natural menopause commonly occurs at 45–55; it is identified retrospectively after 12 months without periods when other causes are excluded. Hormonal contraception or surgery changes assessment.

supports.assessment: Global age range, 12 months and exceptions.
Age range and no hormonal contraception condition.

text.en: Clot risk differs by oral or transdermal route; breast-cancer risk also varies with regimen and duration. Report previous clots, stroke, breast cancer or liver disease before prescribing.

text.en: Nutrition priorities are bone and general health and identifying personal triggers.

text.zh-CN: 牛奶、酸奶或其他合适的含钙食物有助于满足骨骼需要；饮食和活动是长期健康措施，不能保证潮热消失。
text.en: Milk, yogurt or other suitable calcium-containing foods support bone needs; diet and activity are long-term health measures, not guarantees that flushes stop.

supports.assessment: Calcium foods for bone health.

text.zh-CN: 如果咖啡因、酒精、辛辣或很热的饮品反复引发潮热，可减少并记录变化，不必照搬别人的全部禁忌。
text.en: If caffeine, alcohol, spicy foods or very hot drinks repeatedly trigger flushes, reduce them and track changes instead of copying everyone else’s restrictions.

supports.assessment: Potential trigger reduction.

text.en: Black cohosh, red clover and high-dose supplements are not established replacement treatments; quality, effectiveness and medicine interactions need product-specific review.

text.en: Keep regular sleep and suitable activity, and record waking, flushes, mood and treatment changes to identify the main disruption.

supports.assessment: Regular sleep/exercise.

text.en: A suitable lubricant may ease dryness during sex; use condom-compatible products and avoid oil-based lubricants with latex condoms. Seek treatment for continuing pain.

text.zh-CN: 40岁前卵巢功能不全或较早绝经者，医生会额外评估骨骼、生育和激素治疗；不能直接套用年长者的风险结论。
text.en: With ovarian insufficiency before 40 or early menopause, clinicians additionally assess bones, fertility and hormone replacement; findings in older populations do not transfer directly.

text.zh-CN: 围绝经期仍可怀孕，HRT不避孕；应另行讨论适合年龄、吸烟及血栓病史的避孕方案。
text.en: Pregnancy remains possible and HRT is not contraception; discuss a separate method suitable for age, smoking and clot history.

supports.assessment: HRT not contraception.

Clot and smoking risks.

text.zh-CN: 癌症治疗、性别肯定激素或卵巢切除后，症状与检查解读可能不同，需提供完整治疗记录给相应专科。
text.en: After cancer treatment, gender-affirming hormones or ovarian removal, symptoms and test interpretation may differ; provide the relevant specialist with your full treatment history.

text.en: Review sleep, flushes, sexual symptoms, mood and adverse effects to decide whether to continue, adjust or stop treatment.

text.zh-CN: 英国NHS通常建议使用HRT者每年复核；其他地区按当地路径和具体药物安排。新出血或副作用不要等年度复诊。
text.en: The UK NHS generally advises annual HRT review; other regions follow local and medicine-specific pathways. Do not wait for the annual visit with new bleeding or adverse effects.

text.en: Symptoms can return after stopping, requiring a fresh benefit-risk discussion; no single stopping age or duration suits everyone.

text.zh-CN: 雌激素下降与骨量流失有关，骨质疏松意味着骨头更容易折断；风险还受年龄等因素影响。
text.en: Lower estrogen is associated with bone loss; osteoporosis means bones fracture more easily, with risk also influenced by age and other factors.

text.en: Thinner, drier vaginal tissue can cause pain and urinary problems may increase; these symptoms can be treated in their own right.

text.zh-CN: 睡眠与情绪问题可能一起影响工作和关系；心血管风险随年龄和其他危险因素变化，不能仅用是否绝经判断。
text.en: Sleep and mood problems can combine to affect work and relationships; cardiovascular risk varies with age and other factors, not menopausal status alone.

text.en: Rosacea is a recurring inflammatory condition that mainly affects the central face.

supports.assessment: Chronic inflammatory central-face disease.

text.zh-CN: 可有阵发潮红、持续颜色变化、细小可见血管，或像痘痘一样的丘疹和脓疱；皮肤可能发烫、刺痛。

text.en: Some have dry, red or gritty eyes, and some develop thickened nasal skin; different features require different treatments.

text.zh-CN: 病因不是单一感染，遗传、炎症、皮肤屏障和环境因素可能共同作用。
text.en: There is no single infectious cause; inherited factors, inflammation, the skin barrier and environmental exposures may interact.

supports.assessment: Multifactorial inflammatory mechanism.
Genetics, immune response, microbiome and barrier.

text.zh-CN: 日晒、温差、热饮、酒精、辛辣和压力可使部分人发作；诱因因人而异，不等于患病的责任在自己。
text.en: Sun, temperature changes, hot drinks, alcohol, spicy foods or stress may trigger flares in some people; triggers differ and are not a reason to blame yourself.

supports.assessment: Individual triggers vary.
Lists common triggers.

text.zh-CN: 浅肤色更容易看见红斑，但深肤色同样会患病，可能因不明显而漏诊；玫瑰痤疮不传染，也不是不爱洗脸造成的。
text.en: Redness is easier to see in light skin, but darker skin is also affected and may be underdiagnosed. Rosacea is not contagious and is not caused by poor washing.

supports.assessment: Darker skin underdiagnosis.
Not contagious or caused by poor hygiene.

text.zh-CN: 持续面部颜色变化、反复刺痛或丘疹，尤其影响日常生活时预约就诊，并带上护肤品和药物清单。
text.en: Arrange assessment for persistent facial color changes, recurrent stinging or bumps, especially when daily life is affected; bring a list of skin products and medicines.

supports.assessment: History and skin/eye examination.

text.en: Return for increasing nasal thickening or firm bumps; earlier management offers a better chance of limiting progression.

supports.assessment: Early review and progressive difficulty.

text.en: Contact the clinician earlier if treatment is followed by worsening, intolerable effects or eye symptoms.

supports.assessment: Treatment failure referral and urgent eye care.

text.zh-CN: 诊断主要依靠皮肤和眼部表现，没有一项抽血能单独确诊。
text.en: Diagnosis mainly depends on skin and eye findings; no single blood test establishes rosacea.

supports.assessment: No specific test.
Examination and questions; testing only when needed.

text.zh-CN: 医生会询问潮红持续多久、什么会诱发、是否有眼症状及用过哪些外用药；就诊当天不发红也不排除反复性病症。
text.en: Clinicians ask about timing, triggers, eye symptoms and topical products; a clear day at the appointment does not exclude a recurring condition.

supports.assessment: Signs come and go; history needed.
Can be clear at visit.

text.zh-CN: 表现不典型时，检查或小块皮肤取样用于排除狼疮等相似问题，而不是每个人都需要全套检查。
text.en: For atypical findings, tests or a small skin biopsy may exclude conditions such as lupus; a full battery of tests is not routine for everyone.

supports.assessment: Lupus exclusion and biopsy for rare granulomatous presentation.
Biopsy when uncertain.

text.en: Facial redness and bumps have several causes that need distinguishing before treatment.

supports.assessment: Acne, dermatitis and lupus.
Multiple inflammatory and medication-related causes.

text.zh-CN: 痤疮、口周皮炎和脂溢性皮炎都可能像玫瑰痤疮；分布、鳞屑及完整皮肤表现帮助医生区分。
text.en: Acne, perioral dermatitis and seborrheic dermatitis can resemble rosacea; distribution, scale and the full skin pattern help clinicians distinguish them.

supports.assessment: Named alternatives.
Acne and dermatitis alternatives.

text.zh-CN: 护肤品接触反应或药物引起的潮红也要考虑；反复自己加用外用激素可能使面部问题更复杂。
text.en: Contact reactions to products and medicine-related flushing also matter; repeatedly adding topical steroids yourself may complicate facial symptoms.

supports.assessment: Irritation and drug triggers.
Steroid rosacea and advice against topical steroids.

text.zh-CN: 伴其他身体表现或不典型持续皮疹时，医生可能排除狼疮等全身疾病，不能单凭一张照片确定。
text.en: With other physical symptoms or an atypical persistent eruption, clinicians may exclude systemic conditions such as lupus; a photograph alone does not settle the diagnosis.

supports.assessment: Testing sometimes needed for lupus.
Lupus can resemble rosacea.

text.zh-CN: 目标是减少炎症和不适、保护眼睛及控制复发，各种表现分别处理。
text.en: Goals are to reduce inflammation and discomfort, protect the eyes and control recurrence, treating each feature separately.

supports.assessment: Control symptoms and complications.

text.zh-CN: 丘疹脓疱常用外用抗炎药，较重时考虑口服药；持续血管和红斑可能需要不同外用药、激光或光治疗。
text.en: Bumps and pustules often receive topical anti-inflammatory treatment, with oral medicine for more severe disease; visible vessels and lasting redness may need different topicals, laser or light treatment.

supports.assessment: Topical/oral roles and vessel treatment.
Papules versus erythema/telangiectasia choices.

text.zh-CN: 眼部受累可需要眼科、眼睑护理和专用药物；鼻部已经明显增厚时，药物未必能去除多余组织。
text.en: Eye involvement may need ophthalmology, eyelid care and eye-specific medicines; medicines may not remove tissue once nasal thickening is established.

supports.assessment: Eye care and procedures for existing thickening.
Different eye and tissue-removal management.

text.zh-CN: 治疗常需数周到数月逐渐见效；持续护肤和诱因管理帮助维持，不能期待一次疗程永不复发。
text.en: Improvement commonly develops over weeks to months; ongoing skin care and trigger management help maintain control without guaranteeing permanent freedom from flares.

supports.assessment: Gradual response, often 3 months or more.
Maintenance plan and skin care.

supports.assessment: Feature-directed treatment.

text.zh-CN: 甲硝唑、壬二酸或伊维菌素等外用药用于炎症性丘疹；选择制剂时要考虑敏感皮肤和当地批准用途。
text.en: Topicals such as metronidazole, azelaic acid or ivermectin treat inflammatory bumps; formulation choice considers sensitivity and locally approved use.

supports.assessment: Specific topical roles.

text.zh-CN: 多西环素有抗炎作用，并不代表玫瑰痤疮会传染；它可能引起胃肠不适、皮疹或日晒敏感，和铁锌补充剂等存在相互作用。
text.en: Doxycycline has anti-inflammatory effects and does not imply contagious disease; it may cause stomach upset, rash or sun sensitivity and interact with products such as iron or zinc supplements.

supports.assessment: Anti-inflammatory effect.

text.zh-CN: 缩血管外用药可暂时减轻红色，但不处理全部炎症；激光或光治疗也有灼伤、色素改变和瘢痕风险，应由有经验的医生评估。
text.en: Vessel-narrowing topicals may temporarily reduce redness without treating every feature; laser or light procedures can cause burns, pigment changes or scars and need experienced assessment.

supports.assessment: Temporary vasoconstrictor effect and procedure risks.

text.zh-CN: 热饮可先放凉再喝；若辣味反复引发潮红，试较温和版本或减少摄入，观察自身反应。
text.en: Let hot drinks cool; if spice repeatedly triggers flushing, try milder versions or reduce it and observe your own response.

supports.assessment: Concrete temperature and spice adjustments.

text.zh-CN: 酒精是常见诱因，减少或不喝可帮助一些人；不能根据面红推断一个人酗酒。
text.en: Alcohol is a common trigger and reduction or avoidance helps some people; facial redness does not establish alcohol misuse.

supports.locator: Triggers / Not caused by poor hygiene
supports.assessment: Alcohol is a trigger, not diagnostic evidence of drinking.

text.zh-CN: 没有发现个人关联时，不必同时排除奶制品、所有水果等整类食物；先用记录区分重复诱因与偶然碰巧。
text.en: Without a personal association, do not automatically eliminate whole groups such as dairy or all fruit; use records to distinguish repeated triggers from coincidence.

supports.assessment: Diary and avoid identified triggers.
Triggers differ among individuals.

supports.assessment: Comfort, fewer flares and improved treatment.

text.en: Cleanse gently with fingertips and a mild cleanser, rinse with lukewarm water and pat dry; avoid scrubs, vigorous rubbing and repeated exfoliation.

text.zh-CN: 使用耐受的保湿品，并用广谱SPF30或以上防晒配合遮阳；若刺痛，讨论无香精、矿物防晒等替代品。
text.en: Use a tolerated moisturizer and broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher sunscreen with shade; if it stings, discuss fragrance-free or mineral alternatives.

supports.assessment: Moisturizer, SPF30 and alternatives.
SPF30 daily.

text.en: Continue activity; if overheating triggers flares, lower intensity, use shorter sessions and choose cooler surroundings. Eye pain or visual changes require medical assessment.

supports.assessment: Activity can continue with cooling/lower intensity.

text.en: It is uncommon in children, but recurrent red eyes, styes or crusted lids may be clues; clinicians distinguish common infections or allergy and select age-appropriate treatment.

supports.assessment: Pediatric eye clues and differential/therapy.

text.en: Doxycycline needs specific review in pregnancy, breastfeeding and children; clinicians may use it in selected circumstances, but adult long-term skin regimens should not be copied automatically.

text.en: Once controlled, treatment may shift to maintenance; medicine reduction or stopping follows the clinician’s plan while skin care and sun protection generally continue.

text.en: Eye inflammation can involve the cornea and impair vision, explaining why pain, light sensitivity or visual changes need prompt care.

text.en: Long-standing thickening may produce rhinophyma—substantial thickening of nasal skin—sometimes affecting appearance or breathing; preventing progression and reshaping established tissue are different goals.

text.en: Appearance changes and discomfort may lead to social avoidance, anxiety or low mood; psychological support can accompany skin treatment.

text.en: Keep suitable sun protection, gentle care and trigger records; one unexplained flare does not mean care has failed.

text.zh-CN: 不要为消红长期自行用外用激素；若怀疑其他处方药诱发潮红，先联系开药医生调整，不自行停掉必要药物。
text.en: Do not self-treat redness with prolonged topical steroids; if another prescription seems to trigger flushing, contact its prescriber rather than stopping an essential medicine yourself.

text.en: Understanding the cause starts by separating hair-cycle shedding, gradual follicle miniaturization and inflammatory injury.

text.zh-CN: 遗传性模式脱发常见于家族中：男性可见发际线后移或头顶部变稀，女性常见分缝变宽。遗传倾向和年龄不能靠洗发水改变。
text.en: Inherited pattern loss often runs in families: a receding hairline or thinning crown is common in men, and a widening part in women. Shampoo does not change inherited susceptibility or ageing.

supports.assessment: Inherited follicle shrinkage and pattern; shampoo boundary is a mechanism-based explanation.

text.zh-CN: 分娩、发热、手术、明显减重或压力之后，较多毛发可能转入休止阶段，几个月后集中脱落；这个时间差容易让人误认当天的洗头是原因。
text.en: After childbirth, fever, surgery, substantial weight loss or stress, more hairs may enter a resting phase and shed months later; that delay can make the wash when shedding is noticed seem to be the cause.

supports.assessment: Delayed shedding after systemic triggers.
Delayed increased shedding.

text.zh-CN: 斑秃涉及免疫系统攻击毛囊；紧扎发型、反复烫染或拉扯可损伤头发；头皮真菌感染、缺铁、甲状腺疾病和某些药物也可能导致脱发。
text.en: Alopecia areata involves immune attack on follicles. Tight styles, repeated chemical processing or pulling can damage hair; scalp fungal infection, iron deficiency, thyroid disease and some medicines are other possible causes.

supports.assessment: Autoimmune mechanism of alopecia areata only.

text.en: Gradual thinning alone is usually not an emergency; medication reactions and an inflamed scalp need separate attention.

supports.assessment: Usual non-emergency consultation.
Serious drug reaction distinction.

text.zh-CN: 使用米诺地尔后出现胸痛、呼吸困难、明显心跳加快、头晕或手脚肿胀，应立即停止继续自行使用并寻求紧急医疗建议；胸痛或呼吸困难按急症处理。
text.en: If minoxidil use is followed by chest pain, breathing difficulty, a very fast heartbeat, dizziness or swollen hands or feet, stop further self-treatment and obtain urgent medical advice; chest pain or breathing difficulty warrants emergency care.

text.zh-CN: 按英国安全提示，为脱发服用非那雄胺时出现抑郁或自杀想法，应停药并尽快联系医生；已有自伤危险时立即联系当地急救服务并请人陪同。
text.en: UK safety advice says to stop finasteride taken for hair loss and contact a clinician promptly if depression or suicidal thoughts develop. For immediate self-harm danger, contact local emergency services and ask someone to stay with you.

supports.assessment: Stop hair-loss formulation with depression/suicidal thoughts; distinguishes prostate dose.

text.zh-CN: 脱发区明显疼痛、流脓、隆起或迅速扩大，应尽快就诊；炎症可能破坏毛囊，形成无法再长发的瘢痕。
text.en: Seek prompt assessment for painful, draining, raised or rapidly expanding areas of hair loss; inflammation can destroy follicles and leave permanent scarring.

supports.assessment: Severe inflammatory scalp infection may scar.
Early treatment to prevent additional permanent loss.

text.zh-CN: 新出现的秃斑、持续变稀、眉睫毛脱落或头皮不适，可预约全科或皮肤科；困扰情绪也是就诊理由，不必等到大面积脱发。
text.en: Arrange primary-care or dermatology assessment for new patches, progressive thinning, eyebrow or eyelash loss, or scalp symptoms. Emotional distress also justifies a visit without waiting for extensive loss.

supports.assessment: Consult if concerned, including wellbeing.
Early dermatologist assessment for cause.

text.zh-CN: 准备脱发开始时间、分布变化、家族情况、近期疾病或分娩、减重和药物清单；照片能帮助说明就诊当天不明显的变化。
text.en: Bring the onset, changing distribution, family history, recent illness or childbirth, weight changes and medicine list; photographs can help show changes not obvious on the visit day.

supports.locator: How do dermatologists diagnose hair loss?

text.en: If a prescription may be causing shedding, discuss alternatives or adjustment with its prescriber before stopping treatment for the original condition.

text.en: Diagnosis combines timing, distribution and scalp findings rather than a one-day hair count.

supports.locator: How do dermatologists diagnose hair loss?
supports.assessment: History, examination and selective tests.
History and examination establish most diagnoses.

text.zh-CN: 检查可包括头皮、毛发粗细、断发、毛囊开口和指甲；轻拉毛发或放大观察，帮助区分正在脱落和毛囊变细。
text.en: Examination may include the scalp, shaft thickness, broken hairs, follicle openings and nails; a gentle pull test or magnification helps assess shedding and follicle changes.

supports.assessment: Nails and magnified follicle examination.
Hair pull test and clinical inspection.

text.zh-CN: 疑似贫血、营养不足或甲状腺异常时选择相应血液检查；有鳞屑或脓疱时可能取毛发、皮屑或分泌物检查感染。并非每个人都需要全套化验。
text.en: Blood tests are selected when anaemia, nutritional deficiency or thyroid disease is suspected. Scaling or pustules may prompt hair, skin or discharge samples for infection; a complete laboratory panel is not needed for everyone.

supports.assessment: Tests conditional on suspected deficiency, illness or infection.
Blood tests, hair/skin fungal samples and pustule swabs.

text.zh-CN: 怀疑瘢痕性病变或诊断不清时可能取少量头皮做活检；它回答组织是否发炎或受损，不能保证预测每根头发能否恢复。
text.en: A small scalp biopsy may be used when scarring disease is suspected or the diagnosis remains unclear. It examines tissue inflammation and damage rather than guaranteeing regrowth of every hair.

supports.assessment: Biopsy when necessary; outcome boundary is clinical interpretation.
Biopsy may distinguish alternative causes.

text.en: Different conditions may all look like missing hair but need different management.

supports.assessment: Cause-specific management.

text.zh-CN: 均匀增多的脱落可见于休止期脱发；逐渐变细、分缝变宽偏向模式脱发，两者也可能同时存在。
text.en: Diffuse increased shedding can reflect telogen effluvium; progressive finer hairs and a widening part suggest pattern loss. More than one process can coexist.

supports.assessment: More than one cause possible.
Different clinical patterns.

text.zh-CN: 光滑的圆形秃斑提示斑秃；鳞屑、断发和黑点也可能是头癣，属于真菌感染，需要不同药物。
text.en: Smooth round patches suggest alopecia areata; scale, broken hairs and black dots can indicate scalp ringworm, a fungal infection requiring different medicines.

supports.assessment: Patchy smooth loss.
Scaling/broken hair patterns and distinction from alopecia areata.

text.zh-CN: 反复拉扯造成的断发、长期紧扎发型造成的牵拉，以及毛囊开口消失的瘢痕性脱发，都要单独识别；后者治疗重点是保护尚存的毛囊。
text.en: Hair breakage from pulling, traction from tight styles and scarring loss with absent follicle openings need separate recognition; scarring treatment aims to preserve remaining follicles.

text.en: Treatment follows the cause before discussing regrowth goals, time and burden.

supports.assessment: Treat infection, deficiency and inflammation differently.

text.zh-CN: 短期诱因后的脱落可能逐渐恢复；缺铁或甲状腺疾病需处理原病，头皮感染需抗感染治疗。生发产品不能替代这些处理。
text.en: Shedding after a temporary trigger may recover; iron deficiency or thyroid disease needs its underlying treatment and scalp infection needs infection treatment. Growth products do not replace these measures.

supports.assessment: Regrowth after underlying illness and temporary causes.
Diagnosis-directed treatment of deficits and infections.

text.zh-CN: 模式脱发可讨论米诺地尔或适合人群的处方药，目标常是减慢变稀和增加部分密度；不会人人有效，维持效果通常需要继续治疗。
text.en: Pattern loss may be treated with minoxidil or prescription options for suitable patients, often to slow thinning and regain some density. Not everyone responds and maintaining benefit usually requires continuing treatment.

supports.assessment: Pattern loss, variable response and continued use.
Limits, gradual benefit and continued use.

text.zh-CN: 斑秃可观察或采用针对免疫炎症的治疗，例如局部糖皮质激素；严重病例由专科根据年龄、范围和风险选择系统治疗，不能照搬到遗传性稀疏。
text.en: Alopecia areata may be observed or treated for immune inflammation, for example with local corticosteroids. Specialists choose systemic treatment for severe disease according to age, extent and risk; these choices do not transfer automatically to inherited thinning.

supports.assessment: Age/extent-dependent choices, corticosteroids and severe-disease systemic therapy.
Patchy alopecia areata treatment.

text.zh-CN: 假发和遮盖可以立即改善外观；植发、激光或注射项目适用范围和证据各不相同，应先明确诊断和预期，而不是以广告中的长发照片判断。
text.en: Wigs and camouflage can change appearance immediately. Transplantation, lasers and injection procedures have different indications and evidence, so establish the diagnosis and expectations before choosing from advertising photographs.

supports.assessment: Cosmetic and procedure options with no universally effective treatment.
Procedure-specific evidence and suitability.

text.en: Hair-loss medicines target particular causes, and the formulation and eligible population matter.

supports.assessment: Separate indications and use.
Immune-directed treatment belongs to alopecia areata.

text.zh-CN: 外用米诺地尔可帮助部分模式脱发，需要按产品和医生指导持续使用；多涂不会更快。可能刺激头皮，勿涂破损或发炎皮肤。这里的外用建议不能直接套用到口服米诺地尔。
text.en: Topical minoxidil can help some pattern loss and needs consistent use according to the product and clinician. Extra application does not speed results. It may irritate the scalp and should not be applied to damaged or inflamed skin; topical advice does not describe oral minoxidil use.

supports.locator: How should this medicine be used? / Side effects
supports.assessment: External-only product, no dose escalation, irritated scalp and adverse effects.
Benefit and ongoing application, not all safety details.

text.zh-CN: 非那雄胺用于适合的成年男性模式脱发；需讨论性欲或勃起变化、情绪变化及部分性功能症状停药后仍持续的报告。英国 MHRA 与 NHS 都提示这些风险，不能把它当保健品。
text.en: Finasteride is used for suitable adult men with pattern loss. Discuss libido or erection changes, mood changes and reports of sexual symptoms persisting after stopping. Both UK MHRA and NHS describe these risks; it is a medicine, not a supplement.

supports.assessment: Sexual, psychiatric and persistence reports; formulation indication.
Sexual and mood effects with persistence.

text.zh-CN: 头癣常需要口服抗真菌药，洗发剂只能辅助减少传播；局部斑秃可用激素注射等方式抑制炎症。二者病因不同，不能自行交换药物。
text.en: Scalp ringworm generally needs oral antifungal treatment; shampoos are an adjunct to reduce spread. Local steroid injections may treat patchy alopecia areata. The causes differ and treatments should not be interchanged.

supports.assessment: Systemic treatment required; shampoo reduces spore transmission.

text.zh-CN: 饮食主要针对营养不足造成的脱发，没有一种食物可以治疗所有脱发。
text.en: Diet mainly addresses loss related to inadequate nutrition; no single food treats every cause of hair loss.

supports.assessment: Adequate nutrition and deficiency assessment.
Correct deficiencies, with treatment varying by cause.

text.zh-CN: 避免极端节食和长期能量、蛋白质不足；可在日常饮食中安排豆类、蛋、鱼肉或其他合适的蛋白质来源。是否缺铁要结合饮食、失血情况和检查判断。
text.en: Avoid crash diets and persistent energy or protein shortfalls. Include suitable protein foods such as beans, eggs, fish or meat. Whether iron is deficient depends on diet, blood loss and appropriate testing.

supports.assessment: Protein/energy shortfall and tests before supplements; food examples are practical implementation.
Weight loss, haemorrhage and iron deficiency as causes.

text.zh-CN: 补充剂用于纠正确认的不足；盲目叠加多种“生发营养”可能有害，过多维生素 A 或硒等也与脱发有关。
text.en: Supplements are used to correct an identified shortfall. Stacking hair-growth supplements may harm: excess vitamin A or selenium, for example, is also associated with hair loss.

supports.assessment: Excess nutrient-associated hair loss; test and assess before supplementation.

text.zh-CN: 遗传性模式脱发和斑秃不是简单的“缺某种维生素”；均衡饮食有价值，但不能保证逆转毛囊变化或免疫攻击。
text.en: Inherited pattern loss and alopecia areata are not simply a missing vitamin. Balanced nutrition is useful but does not guarantee reversal of follicle changes or immune attack.

supports.assessment: Distinct genetic and autoimmune mechanisms.
Immune and inherited components, not a simple nutritional explanation.

text.en: Care aims to reduce pulling, heat and chemical damage while keeping track of actual changes.

supports.assessment: Gentle handling and reduced physical/chemical injury.

text.zh-CN: 轻柔洗护和梳理，减少高温吹烫、反复漂染和紧扎发型；如果扎发让头皮疼，就放松或更换发型。
text.en: Wash, condition and comb gently; reduce high heat, repeated bleaching and tight styles. Loosen or change a hairstyle that pulls painfully on the scalp.

supports.assessment: Fragile hair, heat, chemical and traction avoidance.
Avoid shaft and traction injury.

text.zh-CN: 用相同光线和分缝拍照，记录脱发范围、头皮痛痒和用药反应，方便复诊比较；不必每天逐根计数。
text.en: Photograph the same part under similar lighting and record the affected area, scalp discomfort and medicine reactions for review, rather than counting every fallen hair daily.

supports.assessment: Clinical distribution and history guide assessment; consistent photographs are an editorial practical aid.

text.zh-CN: 裸露头皮用帽子或防晒保护；眉睫毛缺失时，眼镜可减少风尘刺激。假发要以舒适、不额外拉扯为选择标准。
text.en: Protect bare scalp with a hat or sunscreen; glasses can reduce dust exposure when brows or lashes are missing. Choose comfortable wigs that do not add traction.

supports.locator: Protect bare skin and stay comfortable
supports.assessment: Sun and eye protection; wigs.

text.en: Age, reproductive stage and underlying illness change both likely causes and medicine choices.

supports.assessment: Age and extent affect treatment.

text.zh-CN: 儿童有局部脱发、鳞屑或断发时，需检查头癣等原因；不要直接使用成人生发药。感染相关脱发与斑秃不同，家庭用品传播也需处理。
text.en: A child with patchy loss, scaling or broken hairs needs assessment for causes such as scalp ringworm; do not automatically use adult hair-growth medicines. Infectious loss differs from alopecia areata and transmission through shared items also needs attention.

supports.assessment: Paediatric infection, systemic treatment and shared items.
Finasteride generally not recommended for children; does not establish every drug restriction.

text.zh-CN: 产后数月大量掉发可属于暂时的休止期脱发；若持续恶化、伴疲乏或有头皮病变，应评估其他原因。孕期、备孕和哺乳期先核对药物适用性，不自行开始生发处方。
text.en: Increased shedding months after childbirth can be temporary telogen effluvium. Progressive loss, fatigue or scalp lesions merits evaluation for other causes. During pregnancy, pregnancy planning or breastfeeding, check medicine suitability before starting hair-loss prescriptions.

supports.assessment: Postpartum shedding and alternative causes.
Discuss pregnancy/breastfeeding with clinician.
Finasteride generally not recommended for women.

text.zh-CN: 接受化疗、免疫抑制治疗或有甲状腺疾病的人，需与原治疗团队一起判断原因和恢复预期；不要为了头发中断必要治疗。
text.en: People receiving chemotherapy or immunosuppressive treatment, or living with thyroid disease, should discuss cause and expected recovery with the treating team and avoid interrupting necessary therapy for hair loss.

supports.assessment: Treatment-related shedding and not stopping medicines without clinician.
Treatment and systemic illness-related causes.

text.en: Recovery depends on whether follicles can still function; one fixed regrowth deadline cannot apply to every cause.

supports.assessment: Cause-dependent recovery, permanent scarring.
Different regrowth potential.

text.zh-CN: 暂时诱因解除后，脱落和外观恢复通常需要数月；模式脱发常需长期管理，斑秃可能长回后再次脱落。
text.en: After a temporary trigger resolves, shedding and visible recovery usually take months. Pattern loss often needs ongoing management, while alopecia areata can regrow and recur.

supports.assessment: Months for recovery and persistent inherited course.
Unpredictable course and recurrence.

text.zh-CN: 复诊时比较范围、密度、头皮炎症、用药副作用及生活影响；米诺地尔等药物需要足够时间观察，数天无变化不说明无效。
text.en: Review area, density, scalp inflammation, medicine adverse effects and daily impact. Medicines such as minoxidil need time to assess; no visible change after a few days does not establish failure.

supports.assessment: Gradual months-long response and examination.
Several months for response and adverse-effect monitoring.

text.zh-CN: 快速扩大、新出现疼痛流脓或治疗后明显不适，应提前复诊；怀疑瘢痕性脱发时，保护剩余毛囊比等待自行长回更重要。
text.en: Arrange earlier review for rapid extension, new pain or drainage, or significant treatment reactions. With suspected scarring loss, protecting remaining follicles matters more than waiting for spontaneous regrowth.

supports.assessment: Early intervention prevents further irreversible loss.
Severe inflammatory disease can cause permanent alopecia.

text.zh-CN: 超重或肥胖者可通过可维持的饮食与运动逐步减重；肝脂肪可能先改善，炎症或瘢痕改善往往需要更大的持续改变。避免极端节食和快速减重。
text.en: For overweight or obesity, sustainable eating and activity support gradual weight loss. Liver fat may improve before inflammation or scarring; avoid crash diets and rapid loss.

supports.assessment: Gradual loss for overweight/obesity, activity without weight loss, avoid rapid loss/malnutrition; lifestyle prevention.

text.zh-CN: 即使体重没有明显下降，规律活动仍有益。血糖、血压和血脂的治疗与护肝同样重要。
text.en: Regular activity can help even without substantial weight loss. Treating glucose, blood pressure and lipids is part of care.

text.en: Cirrhosis requires separate management of bleeding, fluid accumulation and other complications. Bariatric surgery or transplantation is reserved for selected assessed situations.

text.en: There is no single medicine for everyone with liver fat; approvals vary by place and time.

text.zh-CN: 美国FDA已批准resmetirom用于部分成人非肝硬化MASH伴中重度纤维化；司美格鲁肽Wegovy也在2025年获相关加速批准。两者都不是给所有超声脂肪肝患者使用的通用药。
text.en: The US FDA has approved resmetirom for selected adults with noncirrhotic MASH and moderate-to-advanced fibrosis; semaglutide Wegovy received a related accelerated approval in 2025. Neither is a universal treatment for an ultrasound finding of fat.

text.en: Accelerated approval relies on surrogate outcomes such as liver histology; long-term clinical benefit still requires confirmation. Contraindications, interactions and monitoring must follow the current local label.

text.en: Avoid self-prescribed detox herbs or high-dose vitamins, which can injure the liver. Diabetes, lipid and weight medicines must be chosen for their specific indications.

text.zh-CN: 饮食目标是改善代谢和保持营养，并没有一种食物能把脂肪肝“洗干净”。
text.en: Food choices aim to improve metabolism while preserving nutrition; no food cleans fat out of the liver.

supports.locator: How can my diet help prevent or treat NAFLD?
supports.assessment: Portions, healthy weight, unsaturated replacing saturated fat, fruit/vegetables/whole grains, reducing sugary drinks.

supports.assessment: Diet quality, less ultra-processed/sugary foods, activity tailored to ability; less certain long-term clinical liver outcomes; normal-weight scope differs.

text.zh-CN: 可用蔬菜、豆类、全谷、鱼和适量坚果搭配餐食，用不饱和脂肪替代部分肥肉、黄油；减少含糖饮料及高度加工食品。
text.en: Build meals around vegetables, legumes, whole grains, fish and modest portions of nuts; replace some saturated fat with unsaturated oils and reduce sugary drinks and highly processed foods.

text.zh-CN: 份量应适合体重和活动量，避免长期饥饿或只吃单一食物；正常体重或肌肉减少者不能照搬肥胖人群减重目标。
text.en: Match portions to weight and activity rather than prolonged fasting or single-food diets. Normal-weight people or those losing muscle need a different plan from obesity treatment.

text.zh-CN: 已有明显纤维化或肝硬化者应避免饮酒；其他患者也应与医生讨论减少酒精。改善化验并不等于已经证明某种饮食能消除所有长期风险。
text.en: Avoid alcohol with advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis; discuss reducing it in other cases too. Better laboratory results do not prove that one diet removes all long-term risk.

supports.assessment: Alcohol intake is recorded; avoid in advanced fibrosis/cirrhosis and discourage otherwise; metabolic and alcohol factors may coexist.

text.zh-CN: 儿童也会出现代谢相关脂肪肝，应由儿科评估并采用适合生长的饮食活动方案，不能套用成人药物或减重指标。
text.en: Children can develop metabolic fatty liver; pediatric assessment and growth-appropriate nutrition are needed rather than adult drug or weight targets.

supports.locator: How do doctors treat NAFLD in children?
supports.assessment: Growing children need healthy food/activity; overweight children may lose slowly, maintain weight or slow gain as appropriate; not adult weight targets.

text.zh-CN: 老人、正常体重或肌肉减少者更需避免营养不足；成人风险评分在不同年龄的解释也不同。
text.en: Older adults, normal-weight patients and people losing muscle particularly need to avoid undernutrition; adult risk-score interpretation also varies with age.

text.zh-CN: 病程差异很大，已有纤维化程度比一次肝酶或脂肪量更能提示长期风险。
text.en: Course varies widely; fibrosis is more informative about long-term risk than one enzyme result or fat estimate.

supports.locator: PDF pp.4–7: natural history and cardiometabolic risk
supports.assessment: Fibrosis predicts outcomes; normal aminotransferases do not exclude significant disease; diabetes, adiposity and genetic contribution.

text.zh-CN: 不少人长期稳定或改善，也有人进展为肝硬化；血糖控制、饮酒和体重变化会影响后续风险。
text.en: Some remain stable or improve while others develop cirrhosis; glucose control, alcohol and weight changes affect future risk.

supports.locator: What are NAFLD and NASH? / Complications
supports.assessment: Fatty liver, inflammatory injury, fibrosis/cirrhosis and associated extrahepatic disease; terminology page retains older NAFLD framework.

text.zh-CN: 复诊看代谢指标、肝酶及纤维化评估，不以肝酶下降就宣布治愈；复查间隔由风险和当地路径决定。
text.en: Follow-up reviews metabolic measures, enzymes and fibrosis rather than calling lower enzymes a cure; intervals depend on risk and local pathways.

text.zh-CN: 确诊肝硬化者还需按专科安排检查肝癌及门静脉高压相关问题；新黄疸、腹胀或出血应提前就医。
text.en: Cirrhosis needs specialist surveillance for liver cancer and portal-pressure complications. New jaundice, swelling or bleeding requires earlier assessment.

text.en: Severe liver disease is not inevitable, but risks outside the liver also matter.

text.zh-CN: 进行性瘢痕可改变肝脏血流和功能，造成腹水、消化道静脉破裂出血及意识变化；严重肝病也增加肝癌风险。
text.en: Progressive scarring changes liver blood flow and function, causing abdominal fluid, bleeding from enlarged digestive veins or confusion; advanced disease also increases liver-cancer risk.

text.zh-CN: 心血管病和糖尿病等常与MASLD并存，不能只盯着超声结果而忽略血压、血脂和血糖。
text.en: Cardiovascular disease and diabetes commonly accompany MASLD, so blood pressure, lipids and glucose deserve attention alongside liver imaging.

text.zh-CN: 预防包括降低首次发生风险，以及减慢已有肝病进展。
text.en: Prevention covers both reducing initial risk and slowing established disease.

supports.locator: How do doctors treat NAFLD? / Prevention
supports.assessment: Gradual loss for overweight/obesity, activity without weight loss, avoid rapid loss/malnutrition; lifestyle prevention.

supports.locator: PDF pp.4–7: natural history and cardiometabolic risk
supports.assessment: Fibrosis predicts outcomes; normal aminotransferases do not exclude significant disease; diabetes, adiposity and genetic contribution.

text.zh-CN: 保持适合自身的体重、活动习惯和膳食结构，及时处理糖尿病及异常血脂，可减少可改变的代谢负担。
text.en: A suitable weight, regular activity, balanced eating and treatment of diabetes or abnormal lipids reduce modifiable metabolic burden.

supports.locator: How do doctors treat NAFLD? / Prevention
supports.assessment: Gradual loss for overweight/obesity, activity without weight loss, avoid rapid loss/malnutrition; lifestyle prevention.

supports.locator: How can my diet help prevent or treat NAFLD?
supports.assessment: Portions, healthy weight, unsaturated replacing saturated fat, fruit/vegetables/whole grains, reducing sugary drinks.

supports.locator: PDF pp.22–27: pharmacological therapy and bariatric interventions
supports.assessment: Medicines/procedures selected for their actual indications and patient context; 2024 guidance cannot independently verify a 2025 approval.

text.zh-CN: 限制酒精并核对草药补剂，避免把其他肝损伤叠加到脂肪肝上；遗传等因素仍会留下不能完全消除的风险。
text.en: Limit alcohol and review herbs or supplements to avoid adding liver injury; inherited factors mean risk cannot be eliminated completely.

supports.assessment: Discuss supplements and herbs because some harm liver; cirrhotic complications and transplant. The obsolete no-approved-drug sentence is excluded.
